answer_1.quote: We develop new tools to build disentangled textual representations and evaluate them on fair classification and two sentence generation tasks, namely, style transfer and conditional sentence generation.
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences with transferred style or conditional attributes

answer_2.quote: We measure the style of the output sentence by using a fastText classifier. For content preservation, we follow  and compute both: (i) the cosine measure between source and generated sentence embeddings... and (ii) the BLEU score between generated text and the input using SACRE-BLEU... we evaluate the fluency of the language with the perplexity given by a GPT-2 pretrained model...

answer_4.quote: Besides the automatic evaluation, we further test our disentangled representation effectiveness by human evaluation results are presented in Tab. 1.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluation assessed the effectiveness of disentangled representations in style transfer, focusing on content preservation and style accuracy.
